title: Keep workload Nix separate from the appliance system generation
rationale: The systemd-repart/systemd-sysupdate appliance deliberately contains no Nix CLI or daemon, and workload edits should not require appliance updates. Agreed direction: after the P/L host baseline, evaluate a separate unprivileged Nix runtime using devenv/Home Manager, with workload outputs distinct from nixosConfigurations and built as signed immutable generations outside the appliance. Rootless Podman/Quadlet is the first fit. Libvirt management is privileged: do not grant unrestricted qemu:///system or sudo; require a fixed host-owned activator with explicit domain, path, network, and lifecycle allowlists and no arbitrary shell/hooks. Keep writable VM disks under /persist. Use nix-keys only for trust/bootstrap identity and nix-secrets for runtime-only credentials; never embed secrets in derivations. A workload update must not be able to alter the booted OS generation, boot, /etc, host users/network, or unrelated systemd services. Threat-model and prototype the boundary before any host-side runtime or deployment.
